slides.text: I thought I was joining the neighborhood watch. Dave from 4B invited me to a 'vigilant community gathering.' They were all wearing dark robes, which I assumed was just a weird HOA thing. Dave handed me a chalice of red liquid. 'To the Dark Lord,' he whispered. I didn't want to be rude—I'm new to the building, and making friends in your thirties is hard.

So I drank it. It was clearly off-brand fruit punch. Dave started chanting in aggressive Latin. I nodded along, tapping my foot, pretending I knew the lyrics. Suddenly, they brought out a live, bleating goat. I panicked. I’m a strict vegan, and my lease explicitly forbids livestock. 'Are we sacrificing it?' I asked, sweating profusely. Dave looked at me like I was completely insane.

'Sacrifice? Steve, this is a petting zoo fundraiser for the local park,' Dave said, highly offended. 'The robes are because it's chilly, and the Latin is just our choir practice for Sunday.' I stared at the goat, then at Dave. 'Then who is the Dark Lord?' I asked. Dave sighed, pointing to a grumpy orange cat sleeping on the sofa. 'That's Lord Voldemeow. He owns the building.'
